summary: The first randomized stress was vacuous: 120 appends and 418 deliveries but every node ended at decided 0, so zero divergences compared nothing. Recorded that and submitted a successor that keeps the lossy phase, then runs a fair-delivery convergence phase (deliver all messages and tick every node for up to 40 rounds), emits a progressed flag, and gates the agreement comparison on progressed=true so a decision-free run cannot satisfy it. The five explained findings remain unchanged; the safety result now awaits a non-vacuous execution.
